selected_modules.reason: The reproducer lives in g++.dg/tree-ssa and checks the optimized EH dump for preservation of an EH-related marker (scan-tree-dump "LP " in the optimized dump) under -O2 -fnon-call-exceptions -ftrapping-math. If the regression comes from incorrect classification or folding of a trapping comparison at the GIMPLE layer rather than a specific optimization pass, this is a primary module.

The issue specifically involves a trapping comparison under -ftrapping-math, making value reasoning and folding semantics highly relevant. A regression could stem from fold/range code treating a floating comparison as non-trapping or otherwise simplifying it illegally in the presence of -fnon-call-exceptions and -ftrapping-math.
